scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: What about a game where you launch a rocket to Mars? You’d calculate the trajectory and use MATLAB in the game.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Hmm... To be honest, I’m not really into rockets... And what’s the point of “sending it to Mars” anyway?

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Ah... Megumi’s reaction is lukewarm. I guess space development might feel too far removed for someone who loves travel...

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Wasn’t someone else already doing that? I think... that guy who’s interning at McDonald’s...

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Crap, she found out. T’ta really *was* doing something like that. This is basically plagiarism...

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Personally, I prefer things like travel or more relatable topics... Maybe something a bit more down-to-earth would be better.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Yeah, you’re right... That idea probably didn’t suit you. Sorry about that.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Oh, not at all! I really appreciate how thoughtful you are, {{playerName}}-senpai. But... how about we make something that feels more like “us”?

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: The air grew a little tense, but Megumi gently tried to smooth things over. Still, a hint of disappointment could be seen on her face.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: By the way, {{playerName}}-senpai... I’m a total beginner at programming. Where should I start?

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: What advice would you give to beginner programmer Megumi?

options.text: Just have Claude Code write it for you
Let’s define the requirements thoroughly and then build it
Start by copying programming syntax by hand to learn the basics
